def modedown(a,f):
    h,w=a.shape
    out=np.zeros((h//f,w//f),int)
    from collections import Counter as C
    for i in range(h//f):
        for j in range(w//f):
            out[i,j]=C(a[i*f:(i+1)*f, j*f:(j+1)*f].ravel()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return out
